 8 die of dengue, 1,595 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 474 
 Published : 10 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 10 November 2026, 17:50
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least eight dengue patients died and 1,595 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, seven were reported in Dhaka division and one in Khulna division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 Read more Five more die of dengue, 2,260 get hospitalised 
 With the latest fatalities, the country's dengue death toll has risen to 474, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 1,53,768.
 Currently, 6,136 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
